page_title: REN 2-2 AUX | Rennes v Auxerre 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Assane Diousse (Auxerre) has tested the patience of referee Eric Wattellier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' Assane Diousse (Auxerre) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
82' Seko Fofana (Rennes) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
77' Substitution. Mousa Tamari (Rennes) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ludovic Blas walks off.
77' Habib Beye decides to make a substitution. Breel Embolo will be replaced by Mohamed Meite (Rennes).
76' Substitution. Assane Diousse replaces Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre).

73' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Brice Samba pulls off an easy save.
72' 2 - 2 GOAL! Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) sends the penalty kick low into the left of the net.
72' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
70' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.

69' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle after Anthony Rouault (Rennes) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Auxerre.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sekou Mara (Auxerre) is coming onto the pitch as Josue Casimir cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' Christophe Pelissier has decided to substitute Ibrahim Osman and he is replaced by Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kevin Danois leaves the pitch and Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) comes on.
67' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
67' Seko Fofana (Rennes) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Donovan Leon.
66' The foul by Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre) was seen by Eric Wattellier who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
64' Breel Embolo (Rennes) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
62' The percentage of ball possession is – 52:48.

62' Rennes slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
58' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) is penalised for holding. Eric Wattellier signals a set piece.
56' 2 - 1 Goal Seko Fofana (Rennes)! Seko Fofana (Rennes) was put through by Esteban Lepaul and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 2:1.
55' Rennes take a short corner kick.

53' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Auxerre are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
51' Rennes fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
48' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Eric Wattellier has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Brice Samba makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
45+2' Rennes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45+2' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Clement Akpa (Auxerre) for his blatant foul.
44' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
43' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post.
42' Rennes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
40' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Auxerre comes to nothing.
37' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked. Auxerre win a corner.
35' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Auxerre was in an offside position.
34' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
32' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Donovan Leon has no trouble gathering it.

32' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Rennes have a corner.
29' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Danny Namaso (Auxerre) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
27' The ball finds it way to Ludovic Blas (Rennes) inside the box and his first-time shot flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
25' Auxerre are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
21' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

18' 1 - 1 Breel Embolo (Rennes) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
18' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
18' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Donovan Leon is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
17' Wonderful movement by Rennes. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
8' 0 - 1 GOAL! Danny Namaso (Auxerre) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
7' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
6' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
6' Breel Embolo (Rennes) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
4' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Eric Wattellier is the one to supervise the game today.
